# Feature gaps (only tracker)

Every session updates its row in the same change that lands, changes, finds or closes a gap. Status: DONE, CODED (need boot), PARTLY, OPEN, DEPARTURE (reason), PARKED. No row = not finished.

Cost line per row where it matters: RAM KB, VRAM KB, AICA KB, ms per frame. Departures from the original: one row each, DEPARTURE + the reason (see docs/DEPARTURES.md).
